narrative.northStar: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding on Material 3 Expressive
narrative.overview: Meowmos pairs Jetpack Compose Material 3 Expressive components with disciplined airport wayfinding contrast so family and group members instantly recognize note spaces, sync states, and destinations.
keyCharacteristics: Adaptive 4-tab ShortNavigationBar (3 tabs for local accounts) and >=600dp NavigationRail
Signal Yellow reserved exclusively for active navigation, primary FAB, pinned markers, and space selection
All #tags searchable and browsable inside SearchPage
Theme-adaptive 5-step heatmap and tabular metrics inside MePage

rules.name: Signal Discipline
rules.body: Reserve Signal Yellow for wayfinding signals only; never flood body surfaces.

rules.name: Single Primary FAB
rules.body: Render the compose FAB in the NavigationRail header on wide screens and in MemosHomePage on compact screens.

dos: Do keep Material You dynamic color active on Android 12+ with seamless static fallback.
Do preserve Spaces destination memory, autosave, comments preview/reply, and predictive Back.
donts: Don't hardcode hex colors inside UI composables.
